column1: # Fixture has 6 columns × 3 rows: int / string / nullable int /
# float / bool / nullable Date32. Bools widen to 1/0; nulls land as
# empty cells; Date32 columns are converted to Excel serials AND
# tagged with the (D1) format so cells render as DD-MMM-YY.
# Wider screen so the "purchased_on" header (12 chars > the 9-wide
# default column) can spill into the adjacent empty column.
# Header row from the parquet schema, in schema order.
# "purchased_on" (12 chars) spills into the empty column on the right.
